concerns.text: Task T034 requires writing a 'methodology_override.md' to document the rejection of GAMs. However, Spec FR-007 is explicitly marked as [REMOVED] in spec.md (Revision History v1.1). There is no active requirement or plan element mandating the documentation of a removed requirement's rejection in the final report. This task has no matching FR/SC/Plan element and creates a circular dependency on a non-existent spec item.

Task T015 is defined as a separate 'Coverage Log' task but its description states it is 'Merged into T013b logic'. T013b already fully implements the logic for SC-001 (Annotation Coverage) including writing `annotation_coverage.json`. T015 adds no unique implementation or verification step, creating a redundant task with no distinct deliverable. SC-001 is fully covered by T013b alone.

Tasks T035 (Runtime Logger) and T036 (Memory Logger) are defined as separate tasks to run 'after' Phase 5. However, SC-004 and SC-005 require measuring the 'end-to-end runtime' and 'peak memory usage during the full pipeline'. Running these as post-hoc tasks cannot capture the metrics of the preceding tasks (T013, T019, T020b) unless they act as wrappers. The current task definitions do not mandate wrapping the execution of previous phases, meaning the implementer cannot satisfy the 'end-to-end' constraint of SC-004/SC-005 with the current task structure.

Task T007 (`entity_linker.py`) is listed as a foundational prerequisite. While the Plan mentions entity linking, Spec FR-001 only mandates 'ingest... and annotate... with exact shortest-path hop count'. The spec does not explicitly mandate a separate entity linking step if the dataset provides node IDs. The task assumes a specific implementation path (fuzzy/embedding linking) not strictly required by the current FR-001 text, potentially creating scope creep or a missing conditional branch in T013 if the data source differs.
